title: Geometric Sequences Ending at 144: How Many? | AMC 10-Style Level 4
description:
How many increasing geometric sequences of three whole numbers end at 144? Vantee shows two ways to find them all, with every trap explained.
Pause the video and try it first, then try the ending-at-72 challenge!
